title: The WalkUp: a concept site for the bar upstairs
tag: Concept site · cocktail bar, Cary, NC
summaryLead: A concept site for the cocktail bar one flight up in downtown Cary. Not a launched project.
story: The WalkUp is a cocktail bar one flight up in downtown Cary, NC, right above happy's. People walk past the door all the time because they don't know it's upstairs. This concept is our own work, and it turns that into the page: a 14-step meter fills as you scroll from the street up to Suite 200, and the menu and running tab wait at the top.

features.title: Scroll staircase
features.text: A 14-step gold meter fills as you scroll from the street to Suite 200.
features.story: Since people miss the door, the climb is the navigation. The meter fills as you scroll and tells you where you are on the way up.

features.title: Menu and running tab
features.text: 49 items in tabs, five specialty cocktail cards, and a tab that stays on the page.
features.story: The menu changes with the season and guests order at the counter, so there's no cart. Tapping an item adds it to a running tab, which is just a tally to plan a round.

features.title: Vector logo and hero
features.text: The gold script logo, rebuilt as vector art and used in the nav, hero and footer.
features.alt: The WalkUp hero with the gold script logo
features.story: The only logo file was a small image that went blurry when stretched. We traced it into vector paths, so it stays sharp from the nav to the footer.

features.text: Photos of the exposed-brick lounge, with the staircase meter running alongside.

features.title: Reviews
